comment: Scion, Graft's pixel mascot: a seedling in a clay pot with a face, 11x8 cells. Legend: L leaf, D leaf shadow, S stem, R pot rim, P pot, E eye. In the app each cell is filled with var(--g-mascot-<fill>) from tokens.css; scripts/generate-icons.mjs uses iconColors (the dark-theme values). `frames` are the animation poses drawn over the sprite: leaf poses replace rows 0-2 (stems excluded), eye frames cover row 5.
